[center][font=Arial Black][size=6][b]void items but cooler and better and also void-er[/b][/size] [img width=48]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53024/53024-1790528593-859885337.png[/img][/font][/center]

[center][/center]
[center][size=2][i]also making a matching krobus portrait/sprite thing and I'm almost done but I still gotta make the trenchcoat one and that sounds scary
